items.title: Gerald Wiggins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 2, 1995
items.q: So Les said to me, “You don’t have a boss and I don’t have a piano player. How would you like to go to California?” So I was young and crazy I said, “Great.”

ctx.x: Anyhow, we were working at the Brooklyn Strand and there was a west coast band backing the show by the name of Les Hite. Well the Army took Les Hite’s piano player, and Step had a little problem he had to talk to the police about so he disappeared. So Les said to me, “You don’t have a boss and I don’t have a piano player. How would you like to go to California?” So I was young and crazy I said, “Great.”
And how old were you then?
